title: Follow responsibility paths within a selected model state
goal: Understand how a selected engineering entity relates to obligations and responsibilities.
context: An engineer investigates a governed entity in one project state.
trigger: The engineer needs to inspect ancestors, descendants, or cross-domain responsibility paths.
preconditions: The engineer can select a model state and starting entity.

interaction.action: Selects a starting entity, relationship types, direction, and any requested limits.
Presents related entities and the typed paths connecting them within that scope.
Changes direction to inspect the corresponding incoming relationships.
Presents the reverse view with its scope and any limits visible.

expected_outcome: The engineer understands the available responsibility paths and whether exploration is complete for the requested scope.

alternatives.condition: The selected cross-domain relationships contain a cycle.
alternatives.outcome: The system finishes exploration without repeating the cycle indefinitely and retains the relevant connections.

alternatives.condition: The engineer requests a bounded depth or result count.
alternatives.outcome: The system identifies the boundary and distinguishes bounded exploration from unrestricted reachability.

alternatives.condition: A fully inspected scope has no related entities.
alternatives.outcome: The system reports no relationships in that specific scope.

failures.condition: A starting entity or encountered reference is missing or ambiguous.
failures.outcome: The system identifies the unresolved entity or path and any incomplete scope.

failures.condition: The model is unavailable, exploration is interrupted, or a resource limit is reached.
failures.outcome: The system exposes the limitation and does not claim complete reachability.

failures.condition: The requested scope spans projects or baselines.
failures.outcome: The system reports that the selection is outside the declared traversal profile.
